title: ChatHealthy SpecialtyMedicare
description: ONE document per NUCC specialty code in the specialtyMedicarePartDQuantityRollUps collection (EPIC-010-F-007-S-009, LLD v83 III.4.3). _id == nucc_code. A provider with multiple NUCC codes is attributed to EACH, so specialty totals overlap; molecule_real_total is the de-duplicated molecule total for reconciliation. Per molecule, the max/min/median/avg statistics of every quantitative measure over the per-provider totals (operator ruling 2026-10-20): median = the middle value; avg = the sum divided by the count; min excludes zeros. Computed in the rollup step's final pass.

nucc_code.description: NUCC code. From the provider NUCC array; never Prscrbr_Type.

molecules.description: One entry per molecule, keyed by the molecule's id. A map rather than an array because the rollup fans out by molecule: each worker writes the keys it owns and no two workers write the same key.

specialty_total.description: This NUCC's attributed all-ages usage of the molecule.

tot_30day_fills.description: Exact decimal. Python parses and sums it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); it is never produced, parsed or summed through a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

tot_drug_cst.description: Exact decimal. Python parses and sums it as decimal.Decimal and MongoDB stores it as Decimal128 (bsonType decimal); it is never produced, parsed or summed through a binary float. JSON has no decimal type, so this contract declares the field a string.

specialty_stats.description: Per quantitative measure: max/min/median/avg over the PER-PROVIDER totals of this NUCC's prescribers of this molecule -- the norm a provider of this specialty is scored against.

max.description: A counted measure. max, min and median are observed values and are integers; an even-length median and the average may divide, so both also accept an exact decimal stored as Decimal128.
